# netactuate_server_ipv4 (Data Source)

Reads a Server IPv4.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_server_ipv4" "example" {
  mbpkgid = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mbpkgid` (Number) Server package ID whose addresses should be read.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ipv4` (List of Object) IPv4 addresses attached to the server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipv4))

<a id="nestedatt--ipv4"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ipv4`

Read-Only:

- `address_id` (Number)
- `gateway` (String)
- `ip` (String)
- `netmask` (String)
- `primary` (Number)
- `raw_json` (String)
- `reverse` (String)
- `type` (String)
